name: refit a sampling distribution to its elite samples
mechanism: draw candidates from a parametrised distribution, keep the best fraction, refit the distribution's parameters to those elites, and repeat so the distribution concentrates on good regions

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Cross-entropy method' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: a general Monte Carlo approach to combinatorial and continuous multi-extremal optimization and importance sampling

requires: a parametrised distribution family (a human prior)
fails_when: premature concentration; the family may not contain the optimum's neighbourhood
